# UNCOVr media

> UNCOVr media is a research driven media agency in Boston, active since 2014. It plans and negotiates audio, video, digital, print and outdoor media for national and local brands. Senior people, led by founder Mike LaBella, do the work.

UNCOVr media works with clients from big to small, national to local, B2B to consumer. Its approach is research first, then the plan is put in motion. Partners are located in Boston, New York, Denver and San Francisco.

## Pages

- [Home](https://uncovrmedia.com/): what UNCOVr media does, its services, clients, leadership and FAQ
- [Work](https://uncovrmedia.com/work/): case studies

## Case studies

- [Kabbage](https://uncovrmedia.com/work/kabbage/): a radio test with no creative that grew into a national rollout
- [Grasshopper](https://uncovrmedia.com/work/grasshopper/): from 4 local markets to a national brand, with 3x CPM savings
- [Society of Grownups](https://uncovrmedia.com/work/society-of-grownups/): media agency of record for a MassMutual company's launch
- [Visit Boston](https://uncovrmedia.com/work/visit-boston/): All Inclusive Boston, a $2.5 million tourism campaign
